title: KPop Demon Hunters 4K Blu-ray Sees Price Discount
excerpt: The 4K Blu-ray version of KPop Demon Hunters is currently discounted on Amazon and Barnes and Noble.
body_html:
The 4K Blu-ray disc version of the animated movie KPop Demon Hunters has received a price reduction at select retailers. While the physical release originally cost $49.95, it is currently available for $24.99 at Amazon and Barnes and Noble.

For some viewers, purchasing the physical disc offers an alternative to maintaining a monthly streaming subscription. The Netflix Premium subscription costs $26.99 per month, making the one-time purchase price of the 4K Blu-ray disc lower than a single month of the streaming tier.
